none: PAS NCL-E11FD7: NCL-E11FD7L: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The seal is approximately rectangular in shape and in section. The obverse is struck 'LVI' within a rectangular die, while the reverse is struck 'OVA'. The sealing measures 16mm in length, 13mm in width and 5mm in thickness.
